name: גְּמַרְיָהוּ
summary: Gemariah son of Hilkiah took Jeremiah’s letter to the exiles. Baruch read Jeremiah’s scroll in the room of another Gemariah, son of Shaphan, who later urged the king to spare it. The verb is joined to the divine name.
note: The short form ends in יָה and the longer in יָהוּ.
